sub_answers.text: In the 1832 presidential election Maryland's electors were chosen in four district elections rather than being awarded based on the statewide vote [d39096094s0p0]. Maryland allocated a total of ten electoral votes in that election [d39096094s0p0].

sub_answers.text: The number of a state's electors equals its total U.S. senators plus its U.S. representatives in Congress [d77541080s2p0]. Most states award electors using a statewide winner-take-all method, a system used by 48 states [d77541080s2p0].
